response.sql: WITH t AS (SELECT r.name, SUM(res.points) AS total, AVG(CAST(res.laps AS REAL)) AS avg_laps, SUM(CAST(res.laps AS REAL)) AS sum_laps, COUNT(res.laps) AS cnt_laps FROM races r JOIN results res ON res.raceId = r.raceId GROUP BY r.name), a AS (SELECT AVG(total) AS avg_total FROM t) SELECT SUM(t.total) AS combined_total_points, SUM(t.sum_laps) / SUM(t.cnt_laps) AS average_laps_completed, AVG(t.total - a.avg_total) AS average_excess_over_average_total FROM t, a WHERE t.total > a.avg_total
